verdict.rationale: Gitleaks is a security scanning CLI, so SBOM generation is a fair question for this kind of tool; the axis applies. Every evidence item describes secret detection in git repos, directories, and stdin, plus rules, baselines, and a GitHub Action. Nothing mentions generating SPDX or CycloneDX SBOMs or inventorying components.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can generate a software bill of materials (SPDX or CycloneDX) for my project or image
